Delhi Sets Up Centers for Idol Disposal and Ganesh Immersion

The Delhi government has established 110 collection centers for damaged idols and 81 artificial ponds for Ganesh immersion. This initiative aims to link religious practices with environmental protection and cleanliness, ensuring the dignified disposal of old and damaged idols during festivals.
